statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band: December NQ has retraced 27.5 points off the low of an 89.75-point overnight band, VIX sits at 15.01 after a 3.29% decline, and no persistent one-way structure is observable.

headline: NQ retraces off its overnight low inside a shallow 90-point band; Tail stays low ahead of the September FOMC minutes
body: The cash Nasdaq-100 closed 6 October at 31,224.69, up 148.24 points or 0.48%, after printing a fresh 52-week high at 31,361.37 and then fading to finish nearer the 31,208.20 session low. Overnight, December NQ futures trade 31,458.75, down 24.50 points or 0.08%, inside an 89.75-point band running 31,431.25 to 31,521.00 after an open at 31,510.00. Price has lifted 27.5 points off that low, so the hour supplies an observed retracement rather than repeated extension after failed pullbacks. The band is roughly 0.29% of the index and sits against a VIX of 15.01, down 3.29% with a 14.96-15.54 range, and December ES at 7,877.25, up 0.04% inside a 9.50-point band. Cross-asset evidence conflicts rather than aligns: Asian cash is softer, with the Nikkei 225 near 70,074.13, down 0.86%, and the Hang Seng near 24,132.13, down 0.61%, while US futures hold flat. Under the published calibration that conflict raises Stress ahead of Tail. The macro backdrop stays restrictive. The H.15 release of 6 October shows 5 October constant-maturity yields at 4.84% for the 2-year, 5.31% for the 10-year and 5.66% for the 30-year, with the effective federal funds rate at 3.88%. WTI at 90.23, up 0.88%, keeps a Middle East supply-risk channel open as an inflation input. The session's catalysts stack into a three-hour window. A 10-year note auction prices at 17:00 UTC into that 5.31% yield, and the minutes of the 15-16 September FOMC meeting follow at 18:00 UTC. Those minutes cover a unanimous 12-0 decision to raise the target range by 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00%, the first increase since 2023, and they pre-date the September employment report released on 2 October showing payroll growth of 29,000 and an unemployment rate of 4.2%. That sequencing leaves room for an abrupt rates repricing in either direction, and the FOMC minutes are structurally multi-stage, so the forecast raises conditional Tail to 23% for the 18:00 UTC hour and holds the WATCH band through the 19:00 UTC power hour into the 20:00 UTC cash close. Equity leadership remains concentrated: Nvidia and AMD both set all-time highs on 6 October, with Nvidia's market value approaching $6 trillion on continued AI demand commentary. Concentration of that kind is a Stress and Confidence input; it does not by itself establish the pathological price path that Tail measures. Shared Finviz context was read and found stale, dated 29 September with a partial collection status, so it was excluded and the assessment rests entirely on independently verified current sources. Current Tail of 11% therefore maps to EA_ON, Stress of 45% sits in the elevated band on rates, energy and event density, and Confidence of 88% reflects verified index, futures, volatility, yield, energy, cross-market and calendar evidence against one stale supplementary feed.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly slots carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 8-13% through the Asian and European hours of 6 October, lifted through the US session to a 22% peak in the 15:00 UTC hour as the index pushed to a fresh 52-week high, and then decayed back to 10-13% overnight as the advance faded into the close and the overnight band compressed. Stress held a narrow 45-48% elevated range throughout and Confidence stayed at 86-88%.
outlookSummary: The modelled path keeps Tail in the low band through the Asian and European hours, lifts it to 18% around the 13:30 UTC cash open for opening-auction structure, and raises it into the mapped WATCH band at 21-23% across the 17:00-20:00 UTC sequence covering the 10-year note auction, the September FOMC minutes and the power hour into the cash close. Tail then decays back toward 11-12% overnight on the assumption that price discovery completes inside the cash session. Every value beyond the current clock-hour is conditional risk, not observed structure.
